title: Cruise Control: Locating the CPP Switch
introduction:
CPP means clutch pedal position. I use this drawing like a map pin with a magnifying glass: the cyan highlight in the transparent vehicle view shows the switch’s general location, and the leader line connects it to an enlarged view of its shape. Match the inset’s callout to the table’s Item column, then read the Description column for the component name.

The table identifies the CPP switch within this cruise-control reference. The drawing supports locating and recognizing it; it provides no physical access sequence, connector pin assignments, electrical test or removal instructions. Recognizing the part is the useful result here—its appearance alone cannot establish whether it works.
